root_review_note.checked: Read full A/B and source abstract, methods, diversity results, qPCR figure captions, modified index analysis, longitudinal results.

issues.planning_caution: Use as a cohort-specific observed trend and a reason to examine heterogeneity, not a confirmed adverse biomarker.
issues.source: Figure 4 reports sequencing FDR p=0.425 and qPCR p=0.201; a downward trend is not a significant difference.

issues.model_claim: Longitudinal stability rules out acute drug confounding and supports baseline microbiome determining efficacy.
issues.planning_caution: No major community-wide change was detected in this small cohort. Do not claim causal determination or elimination of confounding.
issues.source: Only nine longitudinal participants; no statistically significant community-wide diversity change, but some taxa changed and this is not a causal exclusion test.

issues.model_claim: The index failure proves cancer-specific responses.
issues.planning_caution: Frame as limited transferability in this cohort, with cancer type, treatment history, and analytic differences unresolved.
issues.source: A modified index failed to separate response in this cohort; the paper says associations may be unique to cancer type and/or previous treatment history.

strengths: Preserves the enzalutamide-progressing mCRPC population, 23-person cohort, modified-index caveat, and distinction between measured associations and speculative inosine mechanism.
